about.description: SKHY is a single-stock perpetual listed on MEXC, tracking SK hynix Inc. ADR, margined and cash-settled in USD1. Traders get synthetic price exposure only - no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Funding settles every 8h. Up to 20x leverage. Margin is custodied by the exchange rather than self custodied, and access requires exchange onboarding with identity verification.
